# Vision Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews every frame; Awtsmoos.com becomes the vessel where identity, acting, camera, text, persistence, and export meet without divergence.

## Ideal completion universe

- A production scene with three distinct sitcom people and neutral identities.
- Dialogue drives phonemes, visemes, gaze, blink, brows, torso, gestures, garments, and camera cuts.
- Preview and packaged export consume one evaluated performance path.
- The demo has setup, escalation, punchline, title card, captions, multiple shots, and durable reload.
- Every claim is closed by source, test, browser pixels, export artifact, and hashes.

## Possible implementation avenues

1. Reuse the existing scene schema and production renderer.
2. Add a purpose-built one-minute demo data module only where the architecture already expects authored projects.
3. Extend existing verification tools rather than creating parallel test machinery.
4. Reuse packaged-project export for final media evidence.
5. Use Chromium production canvas captures for all scale courts.

## Risks to hunt

- State exists but never reaches geometry.
- Preview and export use different clocks or bridges.
- Locked poses drift after secondary motion.
- Persistence serializes runtime caches.
- Export succeeds structurally but contains blank or loading-shell pixels.
- Text or title cards clip in final framing.
